```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(admixtools)
library(tidypopgen)
library(bigsnpr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s06_f_stats/"
```

# Load and group gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

This script uses admixtools (ref Maier) to calculate F3 and F4 statistics, using the full global dataset, comprising of `r nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` individuals and `r ncol(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` loci.

# Remove all populations with only one individual

```{r}
pop_tbl <- table(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
to_remove <- which(pop_tbl == 1)
to_remove_pops <- names(to_remove)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(!population %in% to_remove_pops)
```

# Create f2 blocks directory

```{r}
if (dir.exists("../data/intermediate/f2")) {
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2"
} else {
  dir.create("../data/intermediate/f2")
  gt_extract_f2(mad_bor_g1000_sum, outdir = "../data/intermediate/f2")
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2"
}
```

# Read in precomputed f2's

```{r}
f2_blocks <- f2_from_precomp(f2_dir) # warning herre consider afprod
dim(f2_blocks)
count_snps(f2_blocks)
```

# Test for admixture: F3(Malagasy; Asian, African)

```{r}
all_pops <- unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

malagasy <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety",
  "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
)
asian <- c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor", "KHV", "CHS")
# removing ,"BEB","PJL"
# african <- c("YRI", "LWK", "GWD", "ESN", "MSL")
# Yoruba, Luhya, Gambian, Esan, Mende

african <- setdiff(all_pops, c(malagasy, asian))

test <- qp3pop(f2_blocks, malagasy, asian, african) # A, B ; C

colnames(test) <- c("Malagasy", "Asian", "African", "est", "se", "z", "p")

test$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han, China", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh, Vietnam", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi, Pakistan", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali, Bengal", test$Asian)

test$African <- sub("ESN", "Esan, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("YRI", "Yoruba, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("GWD", "Mandinka, The Gambia", test$African)
test$African <- sub("LWK", "Luhye, Kenya", test$African)
test$African <- sub("MSL", "Mende, Sierra Leone", test$African)

test$Malagasy <- sapply(
  strsplit(test$Malagasy, "_"),
  function(x) paste(x, collapse = " ")
)

print(test)
```

Admixture f3 statistics were used in the configuration f3(Malagasy; Asian, African) to examine which comparative African and Asian populations show the greatest similarity to the ‘source’ populations of the Malagasy.

```{r}
obj <- test %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  slice(which.min(est))
obj

write.table(
  file = paste0(res_dir, "minimum_f3_malagasy_pops"),
  obj, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Examine z-scores remembering that z-score is affected by population size,
# so interpretation should be careful
test %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  slice(which.min(z))
```

# F3 values grouped descending all combinations

```{r}
test_grouped <- test %>%
  select(est, se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African)

test_grouped$highlight <- "NA"
# test_grouped$highlight[test_grouped$Asian == "Borneo"] <- "Borneo"
# test_grouped$highlight[test_grouped$African == "Mozambique_Chopi"] <- "Mozambique_Chopi"
# find which rows in test_grouped has $African == "Mozambique_Chopi" and $Asian == "Borneo"
test_grouped$highlight[which(test_grouped$African == "Mozambique_Chopi" & test_grouped$Asian == "Borneo")] <- "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
test_grouped$highlight <- as.factor(test_grouped$highlight)

test_grouped %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  arrange(desc(est)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = est, y = reorder(Malagasy, est),
    color = highlight, shape = highlight, alpha = highlight
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "F3 (Malagasy; Borneo, Mozambique_Chopi)", x = "f3", y = NULL,
    color = element_blank(), shape = element_blank(),
    alpha = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = 19, # "Borneo" = 3, "Mozambique_Chopi" = 15,
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = 17
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = "grey", # "Borneo" = "lightpink", "Mozambique_Chopi" = "lightblue",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = "purple"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA" = 0.7, # "Borneo" = 0.7, "Mozambique_Chopi" = 0.7,
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi" = 1
    ),
    breaks = c(
      # "Borneo", "Mozambique_Chopi",
      "Borneo and Mozambique_Chopi"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(res_dir, "F3_all_combinations.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300
)
```

# Outgroup f3's

[@brucato2016a] used an outgroup f3 statistic to investigate the closest Asian population to the Malagasy. An f3 to assess the closest outgroup from a list of alternatives for an admixed population is not accurate, because there is not an equal branch length to the common ancestor. However, here we we will use F3(Asian, Malagasy; African) as in [@brucato2016a] to replicate their result and check our data.

```{r}
african <- c("YRI")

test2 <- qp3pop(f2_blocks, african, asian, malagasy)
colnames(test2) <- c("African", "Asian", "Malagasy", "est", "se", "z", "p")


test2$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han Chinese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh Vietnamese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali", test2$Asian)
test2$Malagasy <- sapply(
  strsplit(test2$Malagasy, "_"),
  function(x) paste(x, collapse = " ")
)

print(test2)
```

```{r}
test2 %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  slice(which.max(est))
```

```{r}
Y <- test2 %>%
  filter(African == "YRI") %>%
  select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y <- Y[order(Y$est), ]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy, " - ", Y$Asian)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() + # , xmax = est - (se/2), xmin = est + (se/2)
  labs(
    title = "F3 (Asian, Malagasy; African)", x = "f3", y = NULL,
    colour = "Asian population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
```

# F4 ratio

To estimate the proportion of each ancestry source within the Malagasy population, we will use an f4 ratio in the following configurations:

f4(GBR,Gorilla;Malagasy,Borneo)/f4(GBR,Chimpanzee;Esan,Borneo)

f4(GBR,Gorilla;Malagasy,Esan)/f4(GBR,Chimpanzee;Borneo,Esan)

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% ungroup()
chimp <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref.gt")
f4_merged_data <- rbind(mad_bor_g1000_sum, chimp,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, use_position = FALSE,
  backingfile = tempfile()
)
```

```{r}
g1000 <- gt_load("../data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.gt")
# append population info
pop_table <- read.table("../data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable",
  sep = "\t", fill = TRUE
)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2", "FID", "Population", "V5", "V6", "V7")

pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table, pop_table$IID %in% g1000$id)

matching_m <- match(g1000$id, pop_table_sub$IID)
g1000$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m),
  pop_table_sub$V2[matching_m],
  g1000$population
)

GBR <- g1000 %>% filter(population == "GBR")

show_loci(GBR)$name <- paste(show_loci(GBR)$chromosome, show_loci(GBR)$position, sep = "_")

f4_merged_data <- rbind(f4_merged_data, GBR,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, use_position = FALSE,
  backingfile = tempfile()
)
```

```{r}
f4_merged_data <- f4_merged_data %>% group_by(population)
```

# Create f2 blocks directory

```{r}
if (dir.exists("../data/intermediate/f2_outgroup")) {
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2_outgroup"
} else {
  dir.create("../data/intermediate/f2_outgroup")
  gt_extract_f2(f4_merged_data,
    outdir = "../data/intermediate/f2_outgroup"
  )
}
```

# Read in precomputed f2's

```{r}
f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2_outgroup"
f2_blocks <- f2_from_precomp(f2_dir, afprod = TRUE)
dim(f2_blocks)
count_snps(f2_blocks)
```


# F4 ratio: estimating the proportion of African admixture

Sister taxon and outgroup on the left, target in the centre, and sister population and source of admixture on the right.

```{r}
malagasy <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety",
  "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
)

pop_matrix <-
  as.matrix(data.frame("GBR", "chimp_ref", malagasy, "Borneo", "ESN"))

qp4_african_p <- qpf4ratio(f2_blocks, pop_matrix)

qp4_african_p$pop3 <- factor(qp4_african_p$pop3,
  levels = c(
    "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego",
    "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
    "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"
  )
)
# order by qp4_african_p$pop3 levels
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
# round alpha to 1 decimal place
qp4_african_p
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s06_f_stats.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)
```
